title: Board inspection and pharmacy self-inspection duties
rule_summary: The Board or its designees may inspect a licensed Massachusetts pharmacy at any time without prior notice and may inspect staff, activities, and records; the pharmacy must provide requested documents. Separately, a pharmacy must perform a Board-tool self-inspection at least annually and within seven days after specified operational changes such as renovation, expansion, relocation, or change of Manager of Record, retaining the completed tool for at least two years.
exam_relevance: Tests both external Board inspection authority and the pharmacy's independent self-inspection obligation.

numeric_facts.conditions: Renovation, expansion, relocation, or change of Manager of Record

common_confusions: An annual self-inspection does not prevent an unannounced Board inspection.
A recent Board inspection does not erase a separate triggered self-inspection requirement.
verification_notes: Current official Massachusetts authority verified during Pre-Batch3 T2 authoring on 2026-08-18; fresh independent legal and realism audit is still required before release.
